title: MAcademy
description: A server where players create history; a server built on trust, understanding, mutual assistance, and the like.
body:
A server designed for various activities: building cities, settlements, and clans; city-vs-city warfare; claiming territory; exploring the world; and much more.

The server is suitable for all players, but especially for content creators; they will be the center of attention, and thanks to them, the server will grow and thrive while generating content for the player base.
